title: Geyser & Floodgate Checklist Generator | Java Bedrock Crossplay Setup
description: Generate a beginner-friendly checklist for installing Geyser and Floodgate on a single server or Velocity proxy network.
intro: Choose your server layout and generate a clear crossplay checklist for Java plus Bedrock support.
howTo: Pick whether Geyser will run on the backend server, proxy, or standalone.
Choose the Bedrock port players should use, usually 19132.
Decide whether Floodgate should allow Bedrock players without Java accounts.
Follow the linked guide and official docs before opening the server publicly.
faqs: Do I install Geyser on every backend server?
For Velocity networks, Geyser is usually installed on the proxy, not every backend.
Use Floodgate if you want Bedrock players to join without owning a Java Edition account.
Common causes include closed UDP port 19132, wrong auth-type, wrong plugin placement, or proxy/backend forwarding mistakes.
